findings.current: The elderly Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent was riding a black panther alongside Yayul Mok’s subordinates.
findings.defect: The draft changes the mounting arrangement: Namho is sharing the black panther with one of Yayul Mok’s subordinates, not riding alongside multiple subordinates.
findings.rationale: The source’s 함께 흑표에 올라타 means they are mounted together on the black panther.
findings.replacement: The elderly Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent was sharing a black panther with one of Yayul Mok’s subordinates.
findings.source: 야율목의 수하와 함께 흑표(黑豹)에 올라타 달리고 있던 늙은 은영각 요원은,

findings.current: At that moment, Yayul Mok, who was riding several dozen yards ahead of us, suddenly spoke.
findings.defect: The distance is substantially inflated: 몇 장 is several jang, roughly a few dozen feet, not several dozen yards.
findings.rationale: A jang is approximately three meters, so the draft changes the stated quantity and spatial relationship.
findings.replacement: At that moment, Yayul Mok, who was riding a few dozen feet ahead of us, suddenly spoke.
findings.source: 그때 몇 장 앞에서 달려가고 있던 야율목이 불쑥 입을 열었다.

findings.current: This was one glimpse of the Nanman Beast Palace, which had built a kingdom of its own in Nanman, thousands of li from the Central Plains—and in the deepest, most secluded part of that land.
findings.defect: The draft reduces 수만 리, tens of thousands of li, to merely thousands of li.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly gives a distance in the tens of thousands, so the current wording alters the quantity.
findings.replacement: This was one glimpse of the Nanman Beast Palace, which had built a kingdom of its own in Nanman, tens of thousands of li from the Central Plains—and in the deepest, most secluded part of that land.
findings.source: 그것은 중원에서 수만 리나 떨어진 남만, 그곳에서도 가장 깊고 은밀한 곳에서 자신들만의 왕국을 세운 남만야수궁(南蠻野獸宮)의 일면이었다.

findings.current: I felt like a cardsharp caught palming a card during a game of Go.
findings.defect: The draft changes both the game and the cheating method: 화투 is a card game rather than Go, and 밑장 빼기 is dealing from the bottom rather than palming a card.
findings.rationale: The source’s joke depends on the narrator feeling like a professional card cheat caught dealing a bottom card.
findings.replacement: I felt like a cardsharp caught dealing from the bottom of the deck during a card game.
findings.source: 화투판에서 밑장 빼다가 걸린 타짜가 된 기분이다.

findings.current: The scene resembled the capital of a small nation so closely that Hyuk Mujin could not stop staring.
findings.defect: The draft changes Hyuk Mujin’s physical reaction from standing with his mouth agape to staring.
findings.rationale: 입은 다물어질 줄을 몰랐다 specifically describes his mouth remaining open, which sets up Taekyung’s subsequent order to shut it.
findings.replacement: The scene looked like the capital of a small nation, and Hyuk Mujin’s mouth hung open in amazement.
findings.source: 마치 소국의 도성(都城)과도 같은 풍경에 혁무진의 입은 다물어질 줄을 몰랐다.

findings.current: “We have arrived. Please stop now and get off already.”
findings.defect: The polite wording weakens Yayul Mok’s exasperated command; 썩 내려라 means to get down immediately, while 제발 conveys frustrated pleading rather than courtesy.
findings.rationale: The source combines exasperation with a blunt imperative, consistent with Yayul Mok’s commanding voice.
findings.replacement: “We’re here. For the love of all that’s holy, stop it and get down this instant.”

findings.current: An iron gate covered in vines and tree trunks opened, revealing countless halls and houses.
findings.defect: The established rendering for 전각 is “pavilion,” not “hall.”
findings.rationale: The binding glossary requires “pavilion” for 전각 unless a particular named building has an established use of “hall.”
findings.replacement: An iron gate covered in vines and tree trunks opened, revealing countless pavilions and houses.
findings.source: 나무줄기로 뒤덮인 철문이 열리며, 수많은 전각과 가옥이 모습을 드러냈다.

findings.current: “One mountain holds four seasons, and ten li bring a different sky.^1 It’s a saying that describes Nanman’s unpredictable nature quite well.”
findings.defect: The footnote reference uses plain caret notation, so Markdown does not associate it with the existing footnote definition.
findings.rationale: Markdown footnotes require the [^1] reference form used by the existing definition.
findings.replacement: “One mountain holds four seasons, and ten li bring a different sky.[^1] It’s a saying that describes Nanman’s unpredictable nature quite well.”
findings.source: “한 개의 산에 계절이 있고, 십 리를 가면 기후가 다르다(一山有四季, 十里不同天). 남만의 변화무쌍함을 잘 표현하는 말이죠.”

summary: Several action, quantity, register, terminology, and Markdown errors require correction.
